item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We are clear: if anyone builds superintelligence with anything like current techniques, everyone on Earth will die. We demand a stop to that race. No company, government, or investor has the right to gamble with humanity’s existence.

2. We refuse to call a race toward human extinction “progress.” If anyone builds superintelligence with anything like current techniques, everyone on Earth will die. We must stop its development before that threshold is crossed.

3. We want a future in which humanity survives. That means stopping the development of superintelligence using anything like current techniques. If anyone builds it this way, everyone on Earth will die. We will not accept that outcome.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We are working to stop a race that ends in human extinction. If anyone builds superintelligence with anything like current techniques, everyone on Earth will die. We state this plainly because the stakes demand plain language, not comforting euphemisms about innovation or disruption. We reject the idea that any company or government has the right to impose that outcome on humanity. We demand a stop to the development of superintelligence using these techniques, and we are organising to make that demand impossible to ignore. Our purpose is simple: we want humanity to survive, and we will fight for the future that this race would destroy.
